objective: Record every pinned file of resolver-dns-native-macos 4.2.19.Final as not ported, with its reason, CLR counterpart and evidence (JNI reader of the macOS resolver configuration); see docs/record-only-modules.md.

ownerDecisions: No project: the module is recorded, not ported (JNI reader of the macOS resolver configuration). Owner decision 2026-11-16 (JVM-only units are recorded with their CLR counterpart instead of placeholder files) and 2026-11-23 (units that need a Java library without a BCL counterpart are recorded, not ported).

statusMeaning.deprecated-not-ported: @Deprecated Java unit (or a unit that serves one) recorded with its deprecation facts; no [Obsolete] facade.
statusMeaning.jvm-only-replaced: JVM-only unit replaced by its recorded CLR counterpart, or JVM build/runtime material with no CLR counterpart.
statusMeaning.library-not-ported: Needs a Java library or JDK-specific API with no BCL counterpart (owner decision 2026-11-23); recorded, not ported.
statusMeaning.clr-adapted: Ported with the original names, structure and comments; every CLR difference is stated in a // CLR: comment and in this entry.
statusMeaning.verified: Every declared original test is mapped to a C# test with the same name (case may differ) and passes.

replacement.clr: DnsServerAddressStreamProviders.platformDefault(): the default (resolv.conf) provider when the macOS type is missing.
noClrCounterpart: The macOS per-domain resolver configuration (/etc/resolver and SCDynamicStore).
